notes.title: The verification algorithm has been changed
notes.content: There is no longer a binding to a pre-generated variant. By increasing the level of difficulty, you also increase the variability of the solution.

notes.title: Autosave size and difficalty
notes.content: Size and difficalty automatically saved when applied. The next time the game is launched, they will automatically be applied.

notes.title: Added effect when puzzle is solved.
notes.content: Solving the puzzle will bring a little more joy. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Added leaderboards by timer
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34046134/8bdfd235e5c87fa8d8768da4767cf4e866c63fb5.png[/img]

In the global leaderboards/leaderboards of friends, added statistics on the time for which the puzzle is solved. Lists are divided by size and difficulty.
